title: Capture to a pasted redline takes no more steps than CleanShot or Shottr
goal: Redlining screenshots is what Photonz is used for most, and its success list promises that someone used to CleanShot X or Shottr gets from a capture to a redline pasted into a chat in no more steps than there. Nobody has counted. Count both sides, and remove the one biggest extra step if Photonz takes more.
notes: measure-redline success item 4; no count exists (searched queue and docs/design/next-measure.md, 2026-10-08). User memory: primary use is UX redlining (measure gaps and sizes). Recent related: redline copy pastes as a picture in Chromium (task find-out-whether-the-redline-copy-pastes-as-a-pi, audit 2026-10-08-redline-paste.json); one-shot copy Shift Cmd C. Example walk: Scripts/playtest/redline-walk.json. Competitor counts come from their public documentation; nothing is installed and no account is made.
acceptance: A table in docs/design/next-measure.md counts every press, click and drag from starting a region capture to having the picture with a size and a gap measured on the clipboard, for Photonz at Next defaults (counted by a walk), CleanShot X and Shottr (counted from their own documentation and release notes, cited, never installed)

If Photonz takes more steps than either, the single biggest extra step is removed in the app when that is under about an hour of work, with the walk recount in the table; otherwise it is filed as a follow-up task with the count
The walk that counts Photonz runs green at Next defaults
Audit written under queue/audits/ if the app changed; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Counted 2026-10-09. Photonz 10 steps at Next defaults (walk capture-to-redline-steps-walk, green, 3 real -sc pictures, screen unlocked): ⇧⌘4, drag, ⇧⌘6, I, I (Size), click, I (Measure again: a landed measurement hands back to Select via finishCreating), I (Gap), click, ⇧⌘C. Shottr 9 from shottr.cc tips + release notes (ruler is one axis per arrow key + click to imprint, editor opens after area capture by default, ⌘C copies). CleanShot X has no measuring tool on its features page or changelog; measuring is PixelSnap 2, at least 5 steps if a size and a gap can share one screenshot, which neither site documents. Table: docs/design/next-measure.md section 13.

Harness: hotkeyEditLastCapture now adopts the picture editor when the newest capture is a picture (adoptCapturedPicture, matched on openedFileURL); before, only a recording was followed. Probe-only code, no app behaviour changed, so no audit.

Biggest extra step vs Shottr: re-picking Measure after the Size click. Removing it is under an hour (finishCreating(layer.id, tool: .measure) for Size and Gap), but it reverses the user's own rule (2026-08-22, 2026-09-15: every tool that makes something hands back to Select), so it went to a decision card instead of being changed. Recommended: Measure stays in hand after Size and Gap only. If approved: change addSizeMeasure/addGapMeasure finish, flip the walk's waitFor tool select + extra I to a single I, recount the table to 9, update the stale STICKY comment on EditorState.activeTool, grep walks that press I after a Size/Gap click.

Adversarial: a first-timer at Next defaults would not know ⇧⌘4 is swallowed by macOS until the system shortcut is turned off (one-time, not counted; CleanShot asks the same). The toast's Edit pill is the mouse path for step 3. Steady state is worse than first time: the mode is remembered, so after a session ending in Gap, I lands on Gap and Size is three more presses away (Gap, Alignment, Distance, Size) unless you click Size in the tool options. Left rough, logged here only: not a new defect, just the cycle order. Filed: a-measurement-layer-thumbnail-shows-the-same-num (layer thumbnails print 33 px and 60 px for a 16 px gap and 30 px height on a 2x capture).

Counted: Photonz 10 steps from a region capture to a picture with a size and a gap on the clipboard (walk capture-to-redline-steps-walk, green at Next defaults), Shottr 9, CleanShot X cannot measure on its own (PixelSnap 2 at least 5, not fully documented). Table in docs/design/next-measure.md section 13, committed 6db2f0ce. The one extra step is re-picking Measure after a Size click, because every tool hands back to Select by the user's own rule; whether Measure should stay in hand after Size and Gap is on a decision card (recommended: yes, Size and Gap only).
